HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Textile Fibres 3.3 Clothing Construction Processes: Stitches 3.4 Clothing Constr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Textile Fibres and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Seams 3.5 Clothing Construction Processes: Mana and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
